# YAML migration compatibility fixtures

Golden outputs were captured with `EngineConfig::load` on main
`9faae55f53e27cea198401ee34b4c66c1898666a` (serde_yaml 0.9.34), before replacing
that parser. They compare the complete typed config, defaults, and byte hash;
they are not snapshots regenerated by the new parser.

| Fixture | Existing source / customization |
| --- | --- |
| installer-native | Exact installer CFGEOF fields, enrolled fixture ID, selected interface and measured GPS location |
| installer-bridge-ble-updater | Native config plus confirmed GPS USB ID, actual `enabled_config` BLE output, updater ring and upward spool |
| reference | Shipped `Component/aviary/config.yaml`, with measured location |
| mobile | Shipped mobile template, with measured location; legacy storage/subject and BLE options retained |
| v0831 | Existing release-system v0.8.31 fixture, with measured location |
| syntax | Block/flow YAML, aliases, quoted numeric-looking ID, null options, integer coordinates and PMTK settings |

Installer writes covered: `node.id`, `node.channel`, `node.status_file`,
`node.storage_class`, `node.location.{latitude,longitude,elevation_meters}`,
`capture.interface`, `capture.hunter.enabled`, `backhaul.broker_urls`,
`backhaul.credentials_path`, `backhaul.target_subject`,
`tuning.edge_processing.deduplication_window_ms`, `tuning.heartbeat.interval_secs`,
`sensors.gps.{device,required,usb_id}`, `sensors.rid_ble.{enabled,unblock_rfkill}`,
`sensors.rid_ble.adapter.usb_id`, and `upward.spool_dir`.
The production installer helpers supplying these are CFGEOF, enrollment,
GPS seed, GPS_USBID_PY, STATUS_CONFIG_PY, RELEASE_CONFIG_PY and
bluetooth-state.py enabled_config. No actual device, node, credential, or host
was accessed; values are deterministic fixture values in real repository shapes.

The Rust test compares the complete CFGEOF mapping with the native fixture,
so newly added baseline installer fields cannot silently escape this coverage.
Existing config validation tests continue to cover unknown keys, strict status
paths, BLE selection, PMTK, location validity, fallback and loaded-byte hashing.
